steps.text: Enter the Lumbridge Castle basement.
Travel with Kazgar to shortcut to Mistag.
Travel with Mistag back to Lumbridge.
Enter Dorgesh-Kaan.
Climb up to the next floor.
Talk to Ur-tag in the north east building.
Enter the railway entrance in the south west of Dorgesh-Kaan.
Clean the artefacts on the specimen table.
Show Tegdak the artefacts.
Talk to Zanik.
Leave the railway.
Go downstairs.
Talk to General Wartface and General Bentnoze in Goblin Village.
Go to Goblin Village, ready to fight.
Make your way to the tower to the south, using the buildings as cover, and climb up the ladder.
Kill the H.A.M. Mage and H.A.M. Archer with a ranged/magic weapon.
Talk to General Wartface and General Bentnoze in Goblin Village again.
Talk to the Sergeants in Lumbridge Swamp.
Enter the Lumbridge Swamp Caves.
Climb down the ladder to the secret H.A.M. base.
Work out how to avoid all the H.A.M guards.
Hide behind the marked crate, and wait for the guards to walk past and around the corner.
Work out how to avoid all the H.A.M guards.
Wait for the guards to go around the corner.
Work out how to avoid all the H.A.M guards.
Run out in front of the final guard, and wait for one of the sergeants to attack them.
Climb down the ladder.
When Sigmund starts using protection prayers, use the ancient mace's special attack on Sigmund to remove them and then defeat him.
Defeat Sigmund.
Untie Zanik.
Travel to Dorgesh-Kaan under Lumbridge, and talk to Ur-tag there.
Talk to Tegdak through the doorway in south-west Dorgesh-Kaan.
Dig up the 6 artefacts in the railway tunnel, clean them, and show them to Tegdak.
Talk to Zanik in the railway, and then go talk to the Goblin Scribe in the north of Dorgesh-Kaan with her.
Talk to Oldak in the north west of Dorgesh-Kaan with Zanik.
